properties.description: tools/test_opencode_plugin.py imports the plugin under node with the same four hooks OpenCode calls and asserts the nudge ARRIVES, not that the code ran: session start yields the orientation; a reflow2 write (tool.execute.after with reflow2_add_decision) followed by session.idle yields the stop nudge through experimental.chat.system.transform; a session that ran a loop check gets no nudge; a directory with no .reflow2 gets nothing at all. The nudge module's own unit tests cover the server-side half: the plugin file in .opencode/plugins/ or ~/.config/opencode/plugins/ reads as installed, and an OpenCode project without it reads as absent rather than impossible. Skips where node is absent rather than failing red. Run by CI after the build.
properties.findings: Run locally 2026-09-14 on the review branch under node 22: all checks passed. The nudge module's 22 unit tests pass, including the three plugin-presence tests added in review.
properties.name: The OpenCode plugin delivers the loop nudge, driven as OpenCode drives it
